Explain and practise: Lucky Number

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# Lucky Number

William planned to choose a four digit lucky number for his car. His lucky numbers are 3,5 and 7. Help him find the number, whose sum is divisible by  3 or 5 or 7.
Provide a valid car number, Fails to provide a valid input then display that number is not a valid car number. 
Note : The input other than 4 digit positive number[includes negative and 0] is considered as invalid.
Refer the samples, to read and display the data.

> Sample Input 1:
    Enter the car no:1234

> Sample Output 1:
    Lucky Number

---

> Sample Input 2:

    Enter the car no:1214

> Sample Output 2:

    Sorry its not my lucky number

---

> Sample Input 3:

    Enter the car no:14

> Sample Output 3:

    14 is not a valid car number
